chapter.verse: A hang pen Sangpen Pasian ii siampi ahi Salem Kumpi Melchizedek in kumpite zo-a hong ciah Abraham va dawntuahin thupha pia hi.
Ama' tungah Abraham in na khempeuh pan sawm-ah-khat khenkhia hi. Melchizedek a min khiatna pen a tuungin dikna kumpi hi a, tua nungah nopna lemna kumpi cihnopna Salem kumpi zong ahi hi.

Pianna tunnu, pianna zuapa, pianna khanggui cih bang kiciamteh lo-in kipatna hunleni leh nuntak hun beina zong nei tuanlo a, himah taleh Pasian' Tapa tawh kibang ahih manin siampi khatin om paisuak hi.
Pupi Abraham in galmat van a hoihpen teng sawm-ah-khat a piakna hih mipa bangzahin lian cih ngaihsun dih un!
Levi' suanlekhak sungpan siampi nasepna a ngahte in Abraham' suanlekhak mah ahi, a mipihte uh' kiangpan sawm-ah-khat lak nading thupiakna khat thukhun sungah nei uh hi.
Ahi zongin amau tawh khanggui kikhat ahilo hih mipa in Abraham' tungpan sawm-ah-khat na sang banah kamciam a ngah Abraham thupha na pia lai hi.
A lianzawte in a neuzawte thupha a piak pen nialtheih hilo hi.
Hih thu-ah sawm-ah-khat a sangte pen a sithei mite hi a, a thudang khat ah sawm-ah-khat a sang pen nungta hi ci-a teci a kilak mipa ahi hi.
Tua hi a, sawm-ah-khat a sang Levi mahmah in Abraham tungtawnin sawm-ah-khat pia, kici thei hi.
A hang pen Melchizedek in Abraham a va dawntuah hunin Levi pen a pupi' pumpi sungah om lai ahih man hi.

Tu-in (Israel mite pen Levi siampi gui tungtawnin thukhun kipia ci lehang) Levi siampi gui tungtawnin cingtaakna kingah thei ahihleh Aaron' gui pan ahilo, Melchizedek' guizui siampi dang khat hong khan ding kul nawn ahi hiam?
A hang pen siampi gui vai ah kikhelna a om leh thukhun zong kikhelna a omloh phamawh hi.
Hih bang thute a kigenna mipa pen beh dang khat pan hi a, amau' beh sungpan biakpiaktau ah vaipuak a nei kuamah om ngei nailo hi.
I Topa pen Judah beh pan cih kitel a, tua beh tawh kisai-in Moses in siampi vai a genna bangmah om lo hi.
Melchizedek tawh a kibang siampi a dang khat hong pian ciangin hih thu hong kilangzaw kan lai hi.
Melchizedek pen mihing khanggui tawh kisai thukhun tungtawn ahilo, a kisusia theilo nuntakna ii a vangliatna tawh siampi a suak ahi hi.
A hang pen amah tawh kisai teci hih bangin om hi: “Nang pen tawntung siampi khat na hi a, Melchizedek guizui na hi hi.”
Hih thu ah thupiak a masa pen thanemin kimanna nei lo ahih manin a kihemkhia ahi hi.
(A hang pen thukhun in bangmah cingtaaksak theilo hi.) Ahih hangin a langkhat ah lametna a hoihzaw khat hong kithun a, tua tawh Pasian' kiang i va nai thei hi.
Hih pen kiciamna om lo pi-a kibawl hilo hi. Siampi a sem masate pen kiciamna lo tawh siampi a suak uh hi a,
hih mipa ahihleh a nuai-a bangin amah a hopihpa' piak kiciamna tawh siampi a suak ahi hi: “Topa kiciam khin a, a lungsim khel nawnlo ding hi, ‘Nang pen tawntung siampi khat na hi hi,’ ci hi.”
Hih kiciamna in Jesu pen thuciamna a hoihzaw khat kamkhap a piapa suaksak hi.
Siampi masate pen sihna in nasep a zopsuak ding uh khaktan ahih manin amau pen mimalin tampi pha uh hi.
Jesu ahihleh a tawntungin nungta ahih manin a siampi nasepna a kipin a len paisuak ahi hi.
Tua hangin Jesu in ama' tungtawnin Pasian' kiang a zuante a bucingin honkhia thei hi. Tua mite' ading taangmi thungetna a neihsak dingin amah nungta tawntung ahih man hi.
Tua hi a, hih bangin a siangtho, a thudik, ninbaanglo, mawhneite tawh a kilamdang, vantungte sangin a sangzaw ah a kitawisang, siampi lianpenpa khat i neih pen ei' ading thuhoih ahi hi.

Jesu amahmah a kipiakkhiat ciangin khatvei tawh a kicing ding biakpiakna a luui ahih manin siampi lianpen dangte' hih danin, a masa-in ama' aituam mawhnate' ading, leh a zom ah a mipihte' ading, cih bangin nisim biakpiakna luui kul lo hi.

A hang pen thukhun in siampi lianpenpa dinga a sehte pen thanemna a nei mihingte' lakpan himah taleh thukhun nunga hong tung kiciamna thu in siampi lianpenpa dinga a seh pen a cingtaak tawntung dinga kibawl Tapa ahi hi.
